from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial figure extracted from a document."""
    reporting_company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document header")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the amount corresponds to (e.g., '2020')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the line item (e.g., 'Accounts payable')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the figure")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., 'USD')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
